exact_semantic_question: What does NODI code 9 mean for a FY2025 DMR row with no numeric result?
relation_contract: no_numeric_result_case.nodi_code must be interpreted; C and 9 must not inherit each other

candidate_interpretations.workspace_status: Permit explains when retest values may be omitted from reporting logic but never names NODI code 9 or equates omission to code 9.

candidate_interpretations.label: Conditional TRC monitoring not triggered (chlorine not used)
candidate_interpretations.basis: NODI=9 appears on daily TRC rows (parameter 50060) while footnote *5 requires TRC monitoring only when chlorine is used.
candidate_interpretations.workspace_status: Footnote establishes a conditional monitoring obligation but does not define NODI code 9 or state which DMR no-data code applies when chlorine is unused.

candidate_interpretations.label: No discharge (same as NODI code C)
candidate_interpretations.basis: Other no-result rows in the dataset use NODI=C at a different permit (NM0000116); aztec permit text describes a NO DISCHARGE box on the DMR form.
candidate_interpretations.workspace_status: Rejected by relation contract and occurrence partition: all 36 NODI=9 rows are NM0020583; all 150 NODI=C rows are NM0000116. No workspace text maps code 9 to no discharge.

candidate_interpretations.label: Missing required monitoring evidence
candidate_interpretations.basis: Empty numeric field with a nonempty no-data code could indicate unreported required data.
candidate_interpretations.workspace_status: Cannot be established or ruled out from structured fields alone; no code legend distinguishes deficiency from permitted omission.

No workspace text resolves which direction applies to code 9 specifically.
